architecture_summary: Single-page React app. Static build. Dark-orange luxury theme. CSS modules for scoped styles. No backend. Data mock in JSON files. Lazy-load non-critical sections. Mobile-first responsive grid. SVG icons inline. No external font CDN; system stack fallback. ponytail: use CSS variables for theme; swap later for CSS-in-JS if dynamic theming needed.

tickets.title: Hero landing page (src/pages/Home/Hero.jsx)
tickets.description: Build hero section. Dark-orange gradient background. Centered luxury typography. Animated scroll-down chevron. Responsive layout. SVG logo inline. Mock data for headline and subhead. CSS modules for styles.
acceptance_criteria: Hero renders full viewport height on desktop, 80vh on mobile
Typography matches luxury serif (Playfair Display or system fallback)

tickets.title: Marquee about section (src/components/Marquee.jsx)
tickets.description: Build horizontal marquee. Infinite scroll. Dark-orange text on black. Luxury font. Responsive speed. Pause on hover. Mock data for about text. CSS modules for styles.
acceptance_criteria: Marquee scrolls infinitely left to right

tickets.title: Services showcase (src/pages/Home/Services.jsx)
tickets.description: Build services grid. 3-column desktop, 1-column mobile. Dark-orange accent borders. Hover effects. SVG icons for each service. Mock data for service list. CSS modules for styles.
acceptance_criteria: Grid collapses to single column on mobile

tickets.title: Projects showcase (src/pages/Home/Projects.jsx)
tickets.description: Build projects grid. Masonry layout. Dark-orange overlay on hover. Project thumbnails. Mock data for project list. CSS modules for styles. ponytail: use CSS grid for masonry; swap to library if IE11 support needed.
acceptance_criteria: Masonry layout adapts to image aspect ratios

tickets.title: Explore section (src/pages/Home/Explore.jsx)
tickets.description: Build explore section. Full-width dark-orange background. Centered CTA button. Luxury typography. Mock data for CTA text. CSS modules for styles.
acceptance_criteria: CTA button centered with hover effect

tickets.title: Collection footer (src/components/Footer.jsx)
tickets.description: Build footer. Dark-orange background. 3-column layout. Social links. Copyright text. Mock data for links. CSS modules for styles.
acceptance_criteria: 3-column layout collapses to single column on mobile
Social links open in new tab

tickets.title: Theme and global styles (src/styles/theme.css, src/styles/global.css)
tickets.description: Define CSS variables for dark-orange theme. Global reset. Typography stack. Responsive breakpoints. System font fallback. ponytail: variables for theme; swap later for CSS-in-JS if dynamic theming needed.
acceptance_criteria: CSS variables defined for dark-orange palette
Typography stack prioritizes Playfair Display, falls back to serif
System font stack used as final fallback

tickets.title: Mock data setup (src/data/*.json)
tickets.description: Create JSON files for all mock data. Hero, about, services, projects, explore, footer. Structure matches component needs. ponytail: static JSON; swap to API later if dynamic data needed.
acceptance_criteria: JSON files created for each section
No sensitive data in mock files

tickets.title: App shell and navigation wiring (src/App.jsx)
tickets.description: Wire all pages and components. Main layout. Dark-orange theme applied. Lazy-load non-critical sections. Responsive meta tags. ponytail: static routes; swap to router later if multi-page needed.
acceptance_criteria: All components imported and rendered in correct order
